scripts.build:template: pnpm clean:template && pnpm template:sync && vite build --config vite.template.config.ts && vite build --config vite.template-style.config.ts
scripts.build: rimraf lib && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.json && pnpm build:template
scripts.build:watch: rimraf lib && pnpm build:template && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch" "tsc-alias -p tsconfig.json --watch" "vite build --watch --config vite.template.config.ts" "vite build --watch --config vite.template-style.config.ts"
scripts.fix: eslint src tests scripts index.js guoba.support.js eslint.config.js --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --fix
scripts.lint: eslint src tests scripts index.js guoba.support.js eslint.config.js --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.test:dist: node -e "const { readdirSync } = require('node:fs'); const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process'); const { join } = require('node:path'); const files = readdirSync('tests/contracts').filter(file => file.endsWith('.test.mjs') && file !== 'source-baseline.test.mjs').map(file => join('tests', 'contracts', file)); if (files.length === 0) { console.log('test:dist: skipped until distribution contracts are added'); } else { execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--test', ...files], { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:template && pnpm typecheck:test && pnpm test && pnpm test:baseline && pnpm build && pnpm test:dist
